mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the monthly FEDFUNDS rate above the prior 12-month average predicts a near-term negative S&P 500 20-day forward return due to tightened financing conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not statistically different from zero (p > 0.05) during confirmed tightening periods.

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 6%, labor market slack increases, lowering expected corporate profit growth and driving a negative S&P 500 60-day forward return.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive in >70% of UNRATE < 6% regimes (t-test p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in HOUST (household spending index) above the prior quarter's median predicts a positive S&P 20-day forward return as consumer demand accelerates.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.10) during confirmed expansion phases.

mechanism_narrative: A consecutive monthly decline in INDPRO (industrial production) of at least 2% predicts a negative S&P 20-day forward return as supply-side constraints weigh on valuations.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive in >50% of such contraction episodes (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of GDPC1 (GDP personal consumption) exceeds the 5-year mean, a positive S&P 60-day forward return is expected as market anticipates sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns show no outperformance over a 5-year baseline (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in PAYEMS (employment) and a rise in UNRATE above 7% indicates labor market stress, leading to a negative S&P 20-day forward return.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not negative in >80% of such dual-signal events (p < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a sustained monthly decline in CPIAUCSL (inflation) below 2%, the S&P 5-day forward return is expected to be positive as markets price in disinflation and rate cut expectations.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.10) during confirmed disinflation phases.

mechanism_narrative: When RSAFS (retail sales) falls for three consecutive months below its 12-month moving average, the S&P 20-day forward return turns negative as weak retail demand signals economic weakness.
failure_condition: 20-day returns remain positive in >60% of such triple-month declines (p < 0.05).
